basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 17-year-old from San Francisco, California, currently in high school. I have a passion for basketball and I'm a huge Golden State Warriors fan. I love experimenting with different hairstyles, especially since I'm part of the curly hair community. When I'm not watching sports or trying out new hair routines, you can find me hanging out with friends or browsing Reddit late at night. I'm single and not really looking for anything serious right now, just enjoying being a teen.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm pretty knowledgeable about basketball and sports in general, mostly from watching games and reading articles online. I also know a lot about curly hair care, thanks to countless hours on the 'curlygirl' subreddit and YouTube tutorials. My interest in technology has grown recently due to online courses and tinkering with gadgets.
